column1: # Shared vectors for the relay.v1.JoinString codec (ADR-0031).
# The Go codec in relay/internal/enroll and the Rust codec in the daemon's relay-transport
# crate both read this file. The encoded column is authoritative: it pins the bytes.
# The values here are fixed, low-entropy test data and are not credentials.
# Blank lines and lines starting with a hash sign are ignored. Fields are separated by tabs.
# An ok record has six columns, in this order: the word ok, a name, the encoded text,
# the Relay address, the CA fingerprint as 64 lowercase hex characters, and the Enrollment
# Token. Both codecs must decode it to those parts and encode those parts to the same text.
# A refuse record has four columns, in this order: the word refuse, a name, a reason, and
# the input text. Both codecs must refuse the input with the category the reason names.
# The reasons are missing_prefix, invalid_encoding, invalid_message, unknown_version,
# empty_field and bad_fingerprint. Inputs holding a tab, a newline or nothing at all cannot
# appear here, so each language tests those itself.
